question: Should OpenClaw add a default-off WebChat-to-last-external-channel mirror setting, fold this into the broader origin-delivery policy, or keep WebChat delivery explicit-only?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the change crosses privacy, authorization, config, duplicate-delivery, and channel-routing policy boundaries that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Decide Under Shared Origin-Delivery Policy
options.body: Use this issue as the narrow WebChat requirement while defining route freshness, authorization, duplicate delivery, and failure behavior with the broader origin-delivery work.

options.title: Ship Narrow Default-Off Mirror Flag
options.body: Add the requested session config only if maintainers accept separate WebChat mirroring semantics and require focused tests plus live channel proof.

options.title: Keep Explicit Delivery Only
options.body: Decline automatic mirroring if maintainers decide Control UI should never reuse stored external routes without an explicit per-message delivery route.

recommendation.title: Decide Under Shared Origin-Delivery Policy
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the narrow WebChat requirement while defining route freshness, authorization, duplicate delivery, and failure behavior with the broader origin-delivery work.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to the live issue and the remaining question is a product/security routing decision.
